paragraphs: Lyssn sells AI software for quality improvement and training in health and human services. The platform provides session transcription and evaluations, and reports fidelity to evidence-based practices. A separate set of training modules covers evidence-based practices and uses AI to evaluate skill growth in real time and provide personalized feedback.

The company describes itself as founded by Ph.D-level clinical researchers and data scientists whose platform uses natural language processing. The about page states that the company was initially backed by funding from the National Institutes of Health.

The about page names the organizations served as child welfare and human services agencies, CCBHCs, crisis response and 988 systems, and behavioral provider systems including telehealth systems and payors. The home page lists state and local governments and HHS agencies among the groups Lyssn serves.

quote.text: Lyssn’s AI platform is purpose-built for organizations caring for people and building healthier communities.
